[center][u][b][color=#ff7700]How to install?:[/color][/b][/u][/center]
[center]1.  Download and install Stardew Valley Expanded first[/center]
[center]2. Download this mod and extract the .zip file[/center]
[center]3. Copy and paste file to \steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods[/center]
[center]4. Press " replace the file in the destination "
5.Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/qsf9ny.png[/img]


I plan to create anime-style portraits for every vanilla character, as well as characters from other mods in the future. However, creating each portrait takes time, so updates may be slow. Thank you for your patience and support!
